newsitem.title: UK: English China Clays says profits improving.
newsitem.headline: English China Clays says profits improving.

text.p: British speciality minerals group English China Clays Plc said on Wednesday that current group profits were better than the previous year.

"Against the background of dull market conditions group profits are showing marked improvement on the previous year, based largely on recovery in the North American operations and cost reduction initiatives," ECC said in a statement released at its annual general meeting.

ECC said sales volumes in the first quarter in its minerals operations had improved by three percent in the Americas/Pacific region but had dropped by one percent in Europe. Dollar revenues from the chemical operations were up three percent.
The company gave no further details.
